behavior.open: On key-down, when no GUI screen is active, Minecraft compares the event key with the configured key.inventory binding and opens ue (GuiInventory); the default binding is E/keycode 18.
behavior.close: While a GUI screen is active, key events go to that screen. Base da.a(char,int) closes on Escape/keycode 1 and restores mouse capture. E is not a close key in the native inventory screen.
behavior.key_repeat: No repeat-specific filter in Minecraft.k(); GUI dispatch prevents a repeated E event from reopening/toggling while a screen is active.

main_slots.coordinate_space: screen coordinates relative to centered inventory panel origin
